How anyone could make this game, and in playtesting think "yes, this is really good!" i do not know. The combat is absolute clunky garbage, enemies will kill you in a few shots, and it just feels all around terrible. I've no idea what the hell they were going for but they missed by a MILE. 

If you love dark souls style combat, avoid this ♥♥♥♥ like the plague. This doesn't only not do that style of gameplay well, but it also does the actual shooting terribly as well. The 3rd person camera is an absolute joke in terms of the hitboxes / line of sight / projectile issues. I was trying to shoot some guys from next to a wall and all of my shots kept hitting the wall until i moved completely away from it and out into the open, which of course just let the enemies shoot me back easily. I've never played a 3rd person shooter that did the line of sight / projectile pathing SO BADLY in my entire life.

As everyone says, this is what I like to call it a Dark Souls with guns!.
The difficulty in this game is quite vary depending on your character's build and playstyle.
Some mobs are easy to deal with, some are just born-jerks.
Some bosses are interesting and exciting while fighting, some are just bigger stupid monsters.
The only thing that is very consistent in this game is the trap.
Traps in this game are always f*cking annoying.
They will come out of nowhere and hit you in the *ss when you expect it the least.
I now realize why people say traps are gay.

This game is really fun and difficult theirs a lot of builds you can play around with and all have ups and downs at first I was thinking shotguns were best and snipers were ♥♥♥♥ then later on i was feeling the other way around the level do have many breaching paths and shortcuts. The only down side i see is the bosses seem to all be glass cannons more or less not the 4 to 6 min long battles of attrition in most souls games. Theirs some side, main, and mini bosses in this game sometimes I feel like you go too long before fighting one.

The bad. glitchs are still in the game the reload one is the worst of them, some areas are just too in favor of some builds over others, the bosses are kind meh most of the time. all guns in this game need a little bit more range expect for shotguns which are fine imo. The game is bit of bullet hell sometimes. Finally it hard to say it didn't end strong but more on the line of it padded itself out a bit too much the whole last level could be deleted from the game and  it would have been enough, however the game could be just making sure it has enough context for the first playthrough because it doesn't have a new game plus yet. The game does shortcuts well but land marks so you understand how to use them well.

The good. is everything else I guess, Game runs well didn't crash for me not once. Has voice acting,lore, and a story with a ending I didn't see coming. 

The game is bit of bullet hell sometimes. so i give this game 7.3 Pretty good for your first game Toadman Interactive.

If you're a fan os souls-like games - don't miss this title.

Good overall.  Can recommend

PS I hope too see DLCs in the future or maybe even Immortal part 2

Welp. I feel I've played long enough to give an OK review. It's thumbs up...

Oh you want more info. Well for starters it's fun. It's got a real cool vibe/art style that is similar to something like Chronicles of Riddick (Dark Athena to be specific) which I love although it has a little bit of that why?how?what for? map design that is probably always gonna pop up when designing a world like this. What I mean is everything is odd and alien and that's cool but even odd alien sentient beings would probably contstruct their buildings with some kind of floorplan for particular reasons. But it's not any kind of big deal as most every Sci-Fi game does this. Also, even though I've seen only a tiny percentage of the weapons and they are cool, no doubt, but they are also weapons from 1970-2000 planet Earth design. One can easily imagine this crazy world was built on top of the ruins of our society far into the future or some such stuff but even then using our old blueprints as a guide...I don't know it just seems like they coulda went a tad further then giving you a Vector only now it has some glowing futurery bits on it. Still like it though, it's not a complaint so much as just I wish they did more but that's being said when I'm just barely out of starter zone.

About the gameplay. Yes it is a challenge and well done IMO. Difficulty isn't just a zillion HP. I'm not new to games but I was playing and playing thinking I'm doing OK then realizing I'm still walking over tutorial messages on the floor. I hadn't even left the starter zone yet! But that's good! 


Anyway USE A MOUSE AND KEYBOARD. Rarely do I try to recommend how someone else should play a game but even though you loose the ability to walk slowly (which is a bummer for me as I like to really get immersed...almost -gasp- role-play) you NEED those headshots, you need that control. You can lock onto targets and I realize now this feature is almost solely implemented for controllers but if you just lock-on then start firing you waste a ton of ammo because they are going to be body shots, no crits and no stagger...controllers suck at shooting games let's face it. Game is so much more fun playing it like a twitchy shooter. Otherwise though it's a Dark Souls type game with guns and it's darn fun. Even if the melee combat is pretty basic, I do wish they went with at least a light/heavy attack system for additional strategy as well as giving the option to stay in melee mode but there ya go. Also there is no blocking from what I can tell but there is a dodge you will use a lot.

Overall I'm having a fun time and isn't that what a video game is suppose to do? So many people review games nowadays like it was suppose to make them see Jaysus but it's just a game.  I like how they took a popular genre (souls-like) and ADDED something instead of a straight copy, which btw isn't always such a bad thing.

I love the dark and bizarre Sci-Fi setting. It's got me wanting like hell to see what's around the next corner but just as much wanting like hell to run back to the "bonfire" and heal and replenish what I need and THAT feeling means they did something right to me. My fav part of DS games is that feeling of knowing you are overextended and knowing that you can reap the rewards (maybe) right now or try and come back stronger. It's time or balls.

Great game, no problem recommending. Runs smooth for me. Older I5 and 1070 SSD. I've got 3 new games lately and 2 are for my VR which was just purchased yet only game I wanna load up after work is this one. 

Great job folks and thanks to the Devs for you work.

I hope this is successfully enough for a sequel or another game from these developers. But, right now, this formula does not translate well. If its the fact that you can easily run out of ammo between check points, enemies able to shoot you while you are still out of range of them, and very unbalanced weapons, this game is so close to a good take on the "souls-like" genera that just falls short.

I freely admit I only played through the first couple of levels, enough to think my critisims are fair but also enough to say there is something here. If you enjoy this type of game at all this one is worth a look, and hopefully improves with patches or with an eventual sequal. But I would say, go into knowing what you are going to get.
